item.title: GOP Fight Over 2028 and Vance Begins, Nvidia CEO Spy Scandal, Biden Cuts Book Tour: AM Update 11/10 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Republicans grapple with the fallout from their devastating midterm losses as GOP donors and neocon figures push to mobilize against Vice President JD Vance for the 2028 presidential nomination. Nvidia launches an independent investigation into CEO Jensen Huang after he admits to an affair with a woman identified by US intelligence officials as a Chinese spy. Former President Joe Biden scales back promotional plans for his upcoming memoir as he continues treatment for an aggressive form of prostate cancer. A 19-year-old college sophomore rides a Democrat wave to victory in Arizona, defeating a former state senator to become the next Maricopa County Superior Court clerk.
